extracted.name: Elote Recipe (Grilled Mexican Street Corn)
extracted.description: This elote recipe is my take on Mexican corn on the cob. Sweet and smoky grilled corn is smothered with mayo, chile, lime, and cheese. You won't find a more delicious side dish or snack!
ingredient_lines: 1 teaspoon fresh lime juice (plus wedges for serving)
½ teaspoon chili powder or ancho chile powder
instruction_lines: Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat. Place the corn on the grill and cook, turning every 3 to 5 minutes, until all sides of the corn are cooked and light char marks form, about 15 minutes total. Remove from the grill.
In a small bowl, stir together the mayonnaise and lime juice and zest.
Spread the mayo mixture over the corn and sprinkle with the chili powder, Cotija, and cilantro. Season to taste with salt and serve with lime wedges for squeezing.
